text:
Predicates:
WildTurkey(x) ::: x is a wild turkey.
Eastern(x) ::: x is an Eastern wild turkey.
Osceola(x) ::: x is an Osceola wild turkey.
Gould(x) ::: x is a Gould's wild turkey.
Merriam(x) ::: x is a Merriam's wild turkey.
RioGrande(x) ::: x is a Rio Grande wild turkey.
Ocellated(x) ::: x is an Ocellated wild turkey.
Premises:
WildTurkey(tom) ∧ ¬Eastern(tom) ::: Tom is not an Eastern wild turkey.
WildTurkey(tom) ∧ ¬Osceola(tom) ::: Tom is not an Osceola wild turkey.
WildTurkey(tom) ∧ (¬Gould(tom) ∧ ¬Merriam(tom) ∧ ¬RioGrande(tom)) ::: Tom is also not a Gould's wild turkey, or a Merriam's wild turkey, or a Rio Grande wild turkey.
WildTurkey(tom) ::: Tom is a wild turkey.
Conclusion:
¬Ocellated(tom) ::: Tom is an Ocellated wild turkey.
